title: The cogsci branches that dominated reading instruction (and still much of it today) focus on declarative, procedural, and conditional knowledge. Metac
summary: The cogsci branches that dominated reading instruction (and still much of it today) focus on declarative, procedural, and conditional knowledge. Metacognition didn't really become a thing until 1978 so its easy to see how early cognitive apprenticeship work doesn't get into it
author: Greg McVerry
